checks.name: postgres-finalizer-integration
checks.database: Disposable local PostgreSQL 17 container (isolated port 55492; stopped after test).

design.channelSource: The finalizer re-reads the currently owned RUNNING job with workerId and attemptId and loads its video.creatorId. Publication refuses if the denormalized job.channelId disagrees.
design.publicationContext: The auto-publish use case verifies the AppContext channel against the current video creator, checks that the channel exists and is ACTIVE or LIMITED, and loads the video scoped to that channel.
design.authorization: Publication and unlisting continue through publishAdminVideo/unlistAdminVideo, including authorize(); no request-body channel is accepted.
design.outcome: The use case returns published, unlisted, waiting, skipped, refused, or failed; the worker logs the outcome. An owner-query failure fails closed.

limits: The PostgreSQL test exercises the real database-backed finalizer but not a complete independent worker process.

The publication transaction now locks and rechecks Creator visibility; only a unit simulation was run for the race because DATABASE_URL was unavailable. A real PostgreSQL race test remains outstanding.
No independent review; K20 remains partially verified and R23 is not marked closed.
